name: Hearing Things
description: If you love the sound of an electric guitar, then what could be better than a massed-ensemble of them, playing nearly the same thing at nearly the same time. Electric Spring 2026 will hear the first performance of the piece 'Minor Tour', written especially for the festival by Peter Brooks. Brooks drew inspiration from the gentle, not quite playing altogether approach of Riley's 'In C' and coupled that with the idea of set pieces but performed in a variable sequence from Harrison's 'Double Labyrinth'.
bio:
‘Hearing Things’ is an electric guitar ensemble which specialises in the performance of minimalist pieces. Their adherence to the electric guitar exploits the instruments' tonal similarities, and allows the structure of the music and the interplay of the phrases to shine through without the sonic, timbral distraction of more conventional ensembles.

They originally formed for a performance of Terry Riley's 'In C', but have since gone on to write their own material including 'Strumming Music' by Thomas Padmore, a piece referring to work by Charlemagne Palestine and 'Schoenberg's Labyrinth' inspired by the Farben chord and written by Ian Baxter.

The piece for Electric Spring 2026 is called 'Minor Tour', written by Peter Brooks and drawing inspiration from both 'In C' and Bryn Harrison's 'Double Labyrinth'.
